references.label: Joseph Smith
references.excerpt: I think that among all of the many wonderful and significant things which the prophet Joseph Smith said, there are few that are of greater import than his declaration to a traveler who had asked how he governed so heterogeneous a people. “I teach them correct principles,” he said, “and they govern themselves.” (See George Q. Cannon, Life of Joseph Smith the Prophet, Salt Lake City: Deseret Book Co., 1958, p. 529.) My brethren and sisters, having been taught correct principles, let us go from this conference with a determination to govern ourselves in accordance with these principles.

references.label: Doctrine and Covenants 133:37
references.excerpt: We have so much to do in this world to spread the influence of this gospel. Let us go forth on our assigned mission.
